THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS an industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompanies thisorder exists between,
Eighteen employees inclusive of Mr. R.M. Somasiri, Mahaweli Camp, No. D 12, Pimburaththewa, Aralaganwila. of the one part
and
Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority, No. 500, T.B. Jaya Mawatha, Colombo 10. of the other part

NOW THEREFORE I, W. D. J. Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations and do by virtue of the powers vested in meby Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amendedby Acts, Nos. 14 of 1957 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint
Mr. K.A.T. Fernando, No. 42 D, Colombo Road, Liyanagemulla, Seeduwa to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him forsettlement by arbitration.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.and Sabaragamu Development.Colombo,22nd June, 2017.

STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether injustice had been caused to the Eighteen employees who worked at the Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority, inclusive of Mr. R.M.Somasiri by their services not being extended after the age of 57 while the services of some other employees have been extended up to theage of 60 and if so, to what reliefs they are entitled.

A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo, this 17th day of May, 2017.

STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE

Whether Mrs. U.M.C.L. Fernando who worked at Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited (Sri lanka) as a Senior Managerhad been caused injustice by not being paid the pension fund which is paid under the Defined Contribution Scheme when an employee isterminated from employment,and if so, to what reliefs she is entitled.
